scope: Seven unchanged candidate catalogues on two hard H/Z directions: 84 map/point rows, 336 native physical results and 4,952 independent checks passed.

execution.overlap: Runs overlap the 20-worker normalization preflight; no timing or scaling comparison claimed.
execution.memory_scope: Base-run peak 6,083,752 KiB is authoritative. Extension ru_maxrss is the cumulative maximum across sequential children; it bounds that child from above rather than measuring its individual peak.

archive_convention: All raw point JSON and logs are byte-preserving gzip. Seven accepted settings and catalogue inventories are shared across both runs. Compact mode records omit only inventories and local_approach.rows, with exact per-point references and original report hashes/sizes. Compact summaries omit repeated reports, retaining original hashes/sizes. No binary or state payload is copied.
limits: Directional finite-range local results, not a global bound, Monte Carlo variance/maxima measurement or cross-section estimate.
No implicit transfer to moved CT-star normals, soft limits, tangent/Gram boundaries, shrinking support or tails.
The original LOCAL_HZ_BOUNDING archive is unchanged.

analysis.precision_scope: QuadFloat wraps pinned Symbolica DoubleFloat with106-bit precision: epsilon2^-105 (the original scan script used a stricter2^-112 rounding oracle; old result files are unchanged). Physical acceptance budgets unchanged.
analysis.reproduction: Decompress point files and script into scratch, then pass base8,extension4,output,base8-frozen.json,and a separate directory containing the two linked old seed point files. Absolute input-path hash keys reflect the replay location.
analysis.base_manifest_timing_scope: All 56 base point files match the retained hash manifest; it was created after the extension and is not evidence of an earlier snapshot.
